{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2011}}
{{main|2011 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2011 World Table Tennis Championships men's doubles''' was the 51st edition of the men's doubles championship.
<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Table Tennis}}</ref>
<ref name=ITTF>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsMD.pdf|title=2011 results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120412045730/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsMD.pdf|archive-date=2012-04-12}}</ref>

[[Chen Qi (table tennis)|Chen Qi]] and [[Wang Hao (table tennis, born 1983)|Wang Hao]] were the defending champions. For this event, Chen partnered [[Ma Lin (table tennis)|Ma Lin]] while Hao teamed up with [[Zhang Jike]].

[[Ma Long (table tennis)|Ma Long]] and [[Xu Xin (table tennis)|Xu Xin]], who were runners-up in [[2009 World Table Tennis Championships – Men's doubles|2009]], won in the final against Chen Qi and Ma Lin 11–3, 11–8, 4–11, 11–4, 11–7.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=24331&Competition_ID=1962& |title=One Step Higher for Ma Long and Xu Xin, Title Secured in Rotterdam |date=2011-05-14 |work=ittf.com |access-date=2011-05-19 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120819225826/http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=24331&Competition_ID=1962& |archive-date=2012-08-19 }}</ref>

==Seeds==
Doubles matches will be best of 5 games in qualification matches and best of 7 games in the 64-player sized main draw.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2011/Playing_system_WTTC2011.pdf |title=2011 World TT Championships Playing System |publisher=ITTF |access-date=8 May 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110322194848/http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2011/Playing_system_WTTC2011.pdf |archive-date=22 March 2011 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=1962&Seeded_Doubles=1&FormParticipants_Sorting=26&FormParticipants_Sorted=& |title=2011 WTTC Seeds - Men's doubles |work=ittf.com |access-date=31 May 2011}}</ref>
